hypothesis: Exact whole-game fingerprints discard official TrackMan games that differ by only a few missing log rows. High-purity entity maps learned from exact historical games can recover additional regular-season game pairs using only pre-pitch state, mapped participants, calendar fields, and team identity, after which exact sequence blocks provide conservative row pairs.

identity_recovery.source: exact one-to-one game fingerprints within the allowed history cutoff only

game_candidates.score: 0.75 * tuple-multiset Dice + 0.15 * pitcher-set Jaccard + 0.10 * batter-set Jaccard

row_alignment.algorithm: difflib SequenceMatcher exact blocks over the locked participant-state tuple

downstream_on_pass: Lock the augmented linkage, then preregister and source-test expanded-selector joint/MoE candidates on 2020/2021 only.
downstream_on_fail: Close the linkage direction without reading downstream control metrics.
